use_cases.name: Synchronise the employee master from the ERP system
use_cases.goal: Apply ERP employee master changes to Nucleus under an explicit field-ownership map, never silently overwriting Nucleus-owned data.

stakeholders.interest: HR edits to Nucleus-owned fields are never overwritten by a nightly sync.
Cost centre and department match the ERP for posting.
Every applied, held, rejected and parked row is logged.

use_cases.trigger: A scheduled nightly batch runs or the ERP system pushes a change.
preconditions: The tenant's master-data mode and field ownership map are configured and validated.
The integration service has valid credentials for the ERP system.
postconditions_success: ERP-owned field changes are applied and emitted as integration.sync.applied.
Conflicts on Nucleus-owned fields are held for review; duplicates and unmatched codes are logged.
postconditions_failure: No record is changed for failed rows; each failure appears in the sync monitor with its reason and can be replayed.

main_flow.action: Sets the tenant's master-data mode on SCR-100: Nucleus-owned, ERP-owned or co-owned.
Defines the field ownership map and validates that no field has two owners and every mandatory field has one.
Pushes or exposes a batch; the integration service receives and logs it. Domain modules never call the ERP directly.
Checks each row's payload hash against rows already applied; new hashes proceed.
Compares ERP values with Nucleus values on Nucleus-owned fields; where none differ the row proceeds.
Applies the upsert for ERP-owned fields and keeps those fields read-only in the Nucleus UI.
Checks for an unmatched external employee code; matched rows complete and are shown as applied on SCR-101.

alternate_flows.condition: An ERP value differs from the Nucleus value on a Nucleus-owned field.
steps: Platform holds the row for review and emits integration.sync.conflict.
HR operations resolves it on SCR-101 under the configured conflict policy.
Every master field is mapped to the ERP and is read-only in Nucleus.

exception_flows.condition: A field is mapped to both owners or a mandatory field has no owner.
exception_flows.handling: The map cannot be saved; the offending fields are listed.

exception_flows.condition: The payload hash has already been applied.
exception_flows.handling: The row is rejected as a duplicate and logged, keyed on the external employee code.

exception_flows.condition: The external employee code does not match any person.
exception_flows.handling: The row is parked for HR resolution; no person is auto-created.

exception_flows.condition: A domain module attempts a direct ERP call.
exception_flows.handling: The call is blocked by architecture; only the integration service may call the ERP.

exception_flows.condition: A user edits an ERP-owned field in Nucleus.
exception_flows.handling: The field is read-only and the edit is not possible.

nfrs: A nightly batch of 5,000 rows completes within 15 minutes.
Every row outcome is retained in the sync log for audit.
Failed rows can be replayed individually without reprocessing the batch.

user_stories.want: the ownership map validated before it is saved
user_stories.so_that: no field is ever fought over by two systems

acceptance.given: I map Department to both ERP and Nucleus
acceptance.then: saving is refused and Department is listed as having two owners

acceptance.given: Cost centre is mandatory and unmapped
acceptance.then: saving is refused and Cost centre is listed as having no owner

user_stories.want: conflicts on Nucleus-owned fields held for my review
user_stories.so_that: a nightly sync never silently overwrites my edits

acceptance.given: batch ERP-SYNC-2026-09-14 sends manager VPI-1039 for E1044 while Nucleus holds VPI-1040
acceptance.then: it is held for review and E1044's manager is unchanged

acceptance.given: the same batch sends department Assembly for E1051, an ERP-owned field
acceptance.then: E1051's department becomes Assembly and the field is read-only in Nucleus

user_stories.want: failed and unmatched rows in a queue with reasons and a retry

acceptance.given: row SY-0006 carries external code VPI-9901 with no matching person
acceptance.then: the row is parked as unmatched and no person is created

acceptance.given: row SY-0007 repeats the payload hash of SY-0001
acceptance.then: it is rejected as a duplicate and shown on SCR-101

use_cases.name: Maintain and validate the GL mapping
use_cases.goal: Keep every pay component mapped to a GL account with balancing legs and dimensions so no run is blocked at approval.

stakeholders.interest: Runs are not blocked by missing mappings at the last minute.
Mapping changes are versioned and approved.

use_cases.trigger: A new pay component or GL account is introduced.
preconditions: The chart of accounts for each entity is available.
Pay components are defined per entity.
postconditions_success: Every component in use has an effective mapping with account, debit or credit side and dimension source, and validation passes.
postconditions_failure: Unmapped or unbalanced components are listed and any run containing them cannot reach APPROVED.

main_flow.action: Lists components per entity with no effective mapping on SCR-102.
Maps each component to an account with debit or credit side and the cost-centre source and dimensions.
Validates that each mapped account exists for the entity and that every debit-only provision has a matching credit leg.
Saves the mapping as a new effective-dated version.
Reviews and approves the mapping version as the second approver.
Revalidates open draft runs and clears the mapping block where all components are now mapped.

alternate_flows.condition: A component's account changes from a future date.
steps: Finance creates a new version effective from that date; earlier periods keep the old account.

exception_flows.condition: A run still contains an unmapped component.
exception_flows.handling: The run cannot reach APPROVED and the message names the component.

exception_flows.condition: A provision is mapped with a debit leg only.
exception_flows.handling: Validation fails and names the missing credit leg.

exception_flows.condition: The same user who saved the mapping tries to approve it.
exception_flows.handling: Approval is refused; a second person is required.

nfrs: Mapping history is retained so any past journal can be explained with the mapping effective at the time.

user_stories.want: a list of unmapped components before payroll approval
user_stories.so_that: I fix mappings before they block a run

acceptance.given: contractor labour charges for LE-02 have no effective mapping
acceptance.then: the component is listed as unmapped for LE-02

acceptance.given: I map it to account 5010700 debit, dimensioned by cost centre and vendor, and it is approved
acceptance.then: the mapping block is cleared

user_stories.want: validation that every provision has a credit leg

acceptance.given: gratuity provision GL-009 is a debit with no credit leg
acceptance.then: validation fails naming the missing credit leg

acceptance.given: gratuity payable GL-024 is added as the credit leg
acceptance.then: validation passes

use_cases.name: Generate and post the salary journal to the ERP system
use_cases.goal: Produce one balanced, employee-level dimensioned journal per run per entity, deliver it to the ERP system and write back the document number.

stakeholders.interest: No lump salary figure to allocate by hand each month.
The run closes only when posting is confirmed.
Each posting is traceable to what was sent and what came back.

preconditions: Every component in the run has a GL mapping for the entity.
The delivery mechanism for the entity is configured.
postconditions_success: A balanced journal exists for the run and entity, is delivered and logged, and the run carries the ERP document number in POSTED_TO_GL.
postconditions_failure: The run is not marked POSTED_TO_GL; the failure is visible in the posting log and can be retried without creating a duplicate posting.

main_flow.action: Computes the cost split at employee level before aggregation, from each assignment as it stood in the pay period.
Confirms every component in the run has a GL mapping for the entity.
Builds one balanced journal for the run and entity, dimensioned, with run type as a dimension, and emits payroll.journal.ready.
Delivers the journal by API, structured file, staging table or manual download, and records what was sent, when, where and the result.
Writes the ERP document number back onto the payroll run and moves it to POSTED_TO_GL.

alternate_flows.condition: The entity uses a structured file or manual download.
steps: Finance downloads the file and imports it into the ERP system.
Finance records the ERP document number on SCR-102.

alternate_flows.condition: The period has more than one run (for example an off-cycle overtime run).
steps: Platform builds a separate journal for each run with its run type as a dimension.

exception_flows.condition: A component has no GL mapping.
exception_flows.handling: payroll.journal.blocked is emitted and the run cannot reach APPROVED; the message names the component.

exception_flows.condition: Debits do not equal credits.
exception_flows.handling: The journal is not released and the imbalance is shown by account.

exception_flows.condition: The ERP system rejects the posting or times out.
exception_flows.handling: The failure is logged and shown; a retry reuses the same journal ID so no duplicate is created.

exception_flows.condition: No document number is returned.
exception_flows.handling: The run stays short of POSTED_TO_GL and is flagged for Finance.

nfrs: Journal for a 600-employee run is built within 60 seconds.
Posting is idempotent on journal ID.

user_stories.want: journal lines dimensioned by cost centre, department and location from employee-level data
user_stories.so_that: I never allocate a lump salary figure by hand

acceptance.given: run PR-2026-08-01 for LE-01 has 412 employees across 9 cost centres
acceptance.then: each line carries cost centre, department and location and the dimension totals sum to the journal total

acceptance.given: an employee transferred cost centre on 2026-08-16
acceptance.then: their cost is split between both cost centres for August

user_stories.want: a re-run of posting not to create a duplicate entry in the ERP system
user_stories.so_that: a retry after a failure is safe

acceptance.given: journal JV-2026-08-0441 was posted and returned ERP-JV-88214
acceptance.then: no second posting is created and the run keeps ERP-JV-88214

acceptance.given: the ERP system rejects a posting
acceptance.then: it appears in the posting log with the error and a retry action

user_stories.want: approval blocked when a component is unmapped
user_stories.so_that: an unpostable run never gets approved

acceptance.given: a component in a draft run has no mapping for the entity
acceptance.when: I try to approve the run
acceptance.then: approval is refused and the component is named

acceptance.given: the component is mapped
acceptance.then: the run reaches APPROVED and the journal is built

use_cases.name: Reconcile payroll to the general ledger, bank and statutory payments
use_cases.goal: Prove after posting that the journal, payslips, bank file, challans, dimensions, overtime and loans all agree, with drill-down from any GL line.

stakeholders.interest: Month-end disputes are settled by the screen, not by spreadsheets.

use_cases.trigger: A journal is posted for a run.
preconditions: The run is POSTED_TO_GL and its bank file and challans exist.
postconditions_success: A reconciliation report shows all seven assertions passing; any GL line can be drilled to employees and payslip lines.
postconditions_failure: Failing assertions are shown with expected, actual and variance and the period cannot be marked reconciled.

main_flow.action: Runs the assertions: gross, net versus bank file, statutory heads versus challans, dimension residue, overtime and loan movement.
Drills any GL line back to the contributing employees and payslip lines.

steps: Finance exports the reconciliation report with drill-through detail.

exception_flows.condition: An assertion fails.
exception_flows.handling: The check shows Fail with expected, actual and variance; the period stays open.

exception_flows.condition: Dimension sums leave a residue against the total.
exception_flows.handling: The residue is shown by dimension and the assertion fails.

exception_flows.condition: A GL line cannot be drilled to payslip lines.
exception_flows.handling: Treated as a failed drill-through assertion and flagged.

nfrs: Reconciliation for a 600-employee run completes within 30 seconds.

user_stories.want: all reconciliation assertions shown passing on one screen
user_stories.so_that: I close the month without arguments

acceptance.given: the September 2026 journals for both LE-01 runs are posted
acceptance.then: all seven assertions pass with zero dimension residue

acceptance.given: the bank file total is 1,000 less than journal net
acceptance.then: the net versus bank assertion fails with a variance of 1,000

user_stories.want: to drill a GL line to employees and payslip lines
user_stories.so_that: I can verify any posted amount

acceptance.given: line 1 of JV-2026-08-0441 debits Basic of 15,000,000
acceptance.then: the contributing employees and their payslip lines are listed and sum to 15,000,000

acceptance.given: I export the drill-down
acceptance.then: it contains the same lines and totals

use_cases.name: Generate and release the bank file under dual control
use_cases.goal: Produce the salary bank file for an approved run and release it only after an independent second person verifies totals out of band.

stakeholders.interest: Salary arrives on the pay date to the right account.
No single person can generate and release payments.

preconditions: Two distinct Finance users hold maker and checker roles.
postconditions_success: The bank file is released and acknowledged; its total equals journal net.
postconditions_failure: The file is held with its reason and no payment instruction is sent.

main_flow.action: Generates the bank file for the run on SCR-055 in the bank's bulk payment format.
Computes record count, total and checksum and confirms the total equals the salary payable credit on the journal.
Flags any employee whose bank details changed inside the payroll window.
Submits the file for release as maker.
As checker, verifies the total and checksum out of band against the run summary and reviews flagged accounts.
Releases the file to the bank.
Returns an acknowledgement, and later any failed credits.
Records the acknowledgement and creates follow-up items for failed credits.

alternate_flows.condition: Some credits fail (for example closed account).
steps: Platform lists failed credits for correction.
A follow-up payment is made after details are corrected and re-verified.

exception_flows.condition: The file total does not equal journal net.
exception_flows.handling: The file is held and the variance shown.

exception_flows.condition: The checker is the same user as the maker.
exception_flows.handling: Release is refused.

exception_flows.condition: A settlement in the run is HELD by clearance.
exception_flows.handling: That settlement is excluded from the file.

nfrs: The bank file is stored encrypted and its download is logged.
Checksum algorithm and format follow the bank's specification.

user_stories.want: release to require a second person who verifies the total independently
user_stories.so_that: no single person can send a payment file

acceptance.given: I generated BF-2026-08-0412 for 412 records totalling 24,118,000
acceptance.when: I try to release it myself as checker
acceptance.then: release is refused

acceptance.given: a second Finance user verifies 24,118,000 and the checksum
acceptance.then: the file is released and the release records both names

user_stories.want: accounts changed inside the payroll window flagged on the bank file
user_stories.so_that: a last-minute account change is checked before money moves

acceptance.given: E1051's bank account changed on 2026-08-28 inside the August window
acceptance.then: E1051 is flagged for the checker

acceptance.given: no account changed in the window
acceptance.then: no flags are shown

use_cases.name: Allocate labour cost to projects and grants
use_cases.goal: Allocate each employee's payroll cost across cost centres, projects and grants by percentage or timesheet and carry it into the journal.

stakeholders.interest: Projects carry their true labour cost.
Grant-funded cost is evidenced by timesheet.

use_cases.trigger: A payroll run is computed for employees with allocation rules.
preconditions: Allocation rules or approved timesheets exist for the period.
postconditions_success: Journal lines carry project and grant dimensions with no residue.
postconditions_failure: Unallocated cost is posted to the default cost centre and flagged.

main_flow.action: Defines effective-dated allocation rules per employee by percentage across cost centres, projects and grants.
Approves timesheets for employees allocated by time.
Computes each employee's allocation per component before aggregation.
Builds journal lines dimensioned by project and grant.
Asserts that dimension totals equal the run total with no residue.
Reviews project cost and drills to employees.

steps: Platform prorates allocation by days in each rule.

exception_flows.condition: Percentages do not sum to 100.
exception_flows.handling: The rule cannot be saved.

exception_flows.condition: An approved timesheet is missing.
exception_flows.handling: Cost goes to the default cost centre and the employee is flagged.

nfrs: Allocation adds no more than 20% to journal build time.

user_stories.want: to split an employee's cost 60/40 across two projects
user_stories.so_that: project budgets show real labour cost

acceptance.given: an employee's rule is 60% project A and 40% project B with monthly cost 100,000
acceptance.then: project A carries 60,000 and project B 40,000

acceptance.given: I enter 60% and 30%
acceptance.then: the rule is refused because it totals 90%

user_stories.want: timesheet-based allocation to use my approved timesheets

acceptance.given: an approved timesheet shows 120 hours on a grant and 40 on operations
acceptance.then: cost splits 75% to the grant and 25% to operations

acceptance.given: no approved timesheet exists
acceptance.then: cost goes to the default cost centre and the employee is flagged

use_cases.name: Accrue leave encashment and gratuity liabilities
use_cases.goal: Compute monthly accruals for leave encashment and gratuity liabilities and post them to the GL with balancing entries.

stakeholders.interest: Liabilities in the books match employee entitlements.
Accruals reconcile to the annual valuation (to be validated by Legal).

use_cases.trigger: Month end after the regular payroll run is approved.
preconditions: Leave balances and wage bases are final for the month.
Provision and payable accounts are mapped with both legs.
postconditions_success: An accrual journal is posted with movement from the prior month and per-employee detail.
postconditions_failure: The accrual journal is not posted and the reason is shown.

main_flow.action: Computes leave encashment liability per employee as encashable balance times daily wage base.
Computes gratuity liability per employee as 15/26 of last drawn Basic plus DA times completed years (to be validated by Legal).
Computes the movement against the prior month's closing liability.
Builds a balanced accrual journal debiting provisions and crediting payables.
Reviews and approves the accrual journal.
Posts the journal to the ERP system and records the document number.

alternate_flows.condition: An actuarial valuation figure is supplied for the year.
steps: Finance enters the valuation and the platform posts a true-up entry.

exception_flows.condition: A provision has no credit leg mapped.
exception_flows.handling: The journal is not built and the missing account is named.

nfrs: Accrual for 600 employees completes within 2 minutes.

user_stories.want: monthly leave encashment liability from actual balances
user_stories.so_that: the books carry the real obligation

acceptance.given: E1068 has 9.5 encashable days and a daily wage base of 1,658.46
acceptance.then: his leave liability is 15,755

acceptance.given: the prior month's liability was 14,100
acceptance.then: a 1,655 accrual is posted

acceptance.given: gratuity provision and payable accounts are mapped
acceptance.then: total debits equal total credits

acceptance.given: the payable account is missing
acceptance.then: the build fails naming the missing account

use_cases.name: Compare workforce budget with actuals
use_cases.goal: Show budgeted versus actual headcount and cost by entity, site and cost centre so Finance can act on variances.
use_cases.trigger: Month end or a budget review.
preconditions: Budgets by entity, site, cost centre and month are loaded.
postconditions_success: A variance view exists for the month with drill-down.
postconditions_failure: The comparison is not produced and the missing budget or posting is named.

main_flow.action: Loads or edits the monthly budget for headcount and cost by entity, site and cost centre.
Computes actual headcount as at month end from assignments.
Computes actual cost from posted journals by the same dimensions.
Shows variance in number and percent and highlights over-budget lines beyond a 5% threshold.
Drills a variance to positions and employees.
Exports the comparison for the budget review.

alternate_flows.condition: A revised budget is approved mid-year.
steps: Finance loads it as a new version from its effective month.

exception_flows.condition: The month's payroll is not posted.
exception_flows.handling: Cost actuals are shown as provisional with the unposted run named.

nfrs: Comparison for 2 entities and 5 sites loads within 3 seconds.

user_stories.want: headcount and cost variance by site
user_stories.so_that: I can challenge over-budget sites early

acceptance.given: LE-01 budgeted 410 for September and actual is 418
acceptance.then: a variance of +8 (2.0%) is shown

acceptance.given: Peenya Works cost exceeds budget by 7%
acceptance.then: the line is highlighted as over the 5% threshold

user_stories.want: to drill a headcount variance to positions
user_stories.so_that: I know which hires caused it

acceptance.given: a cost centre is 3 over budget
acceptance.then: the 3 positions and employees filled above budget are listed

acceptance.given: I export the drill-down
acceptance.then: it lists the same positions
